data.name: Milivoj
data.long_meaning: Milivoj is a Slavic name derived from the elements 'mil' (gracious) and 'voj' (warrior, soldier). The name signifies a gracious gift from God to a warrior or soldier. In Slavic folklore, it was believed that gods granted their favors to warriors before battles, ensuring their success and protection.
